key.name: enable-extension
key.description: Whether to enable the entire UNIM extension

key.name: show-notification
key.description: Whether to show a notification when text is converted (Main.notify)

key.name: show-panel-indicator
key.description: Whether to show the Korean/English status indicator in the panel (Panel.statusArea)

key.name: panel-click-action
key.description: 'toggle-mode': Left-click toggles Korean/English, right-click opens menu. 'menu': Both buttons open menu (GNOME default).

key.name: enable-ime
key.description: Enable real-time Korean input method (Clutter.InputMethod, Wayland only)

key.name: shortcut-normal
key.description: Convert English to Korean and paste

key.name: shortcut-normal-reverse
key.description: Convert Korean to English and paste

key.name: shortcut-register-userdict
key.summary: Register Selection to Reverse User Dictionary
key.description: Read the selected text (Korean or English) and register the corresponding English word to the reverse AutoTypeFix user dictionary.
